definition_de: etwas so kaputt machen, dass es nicht mehr existiert oder nicht mehr zu gebrauchen ist (ein Sturm zerstört Häuser; übertragen: Vertrauen, Hoffnungen zerstören)
example_de: Eine große Welle hat die Sandburg zerstört, die die Kinder den ganzen Nachmittag gebaut hatten.
example_en: A big wave destroyed the sandcastle that the children had been building all afternoon.
visual_idea: Collocation 'eine Welle / ein Sturm zerstört etw.': two children in shock in front of the ruins of their sandcastle, the seawater still flowing back. The image shows the result (only a heap of wet sand and a broken tower stump left), because a wave mid-crash gets drawn with the castle still intact. The video shows the wave destroying the intact castle (start frame).
image_prompt: the ruins of a sandcastle on a North Sea beach right after a wave has washed over it, only a low shapeless heap of wet slumped sand left, with crumbled wall pieces and the broken stump of a single tower, foamy seawater flowing back to the sea around it, two children kneeling in front of the ruins with shocked faces and their hands on their heads, a red plastic bucket and spade beside them, cloudy sky, low angle
negative_prompt: text, letters, watermark, signature, caption, blurry, extra fingers, deformed hands, cluttered background, multiple panels
video_start_prompt: a big detailed sandcastle with towers and walls standing intact on a North Sea beach near the waterline, two proud children kneeling in front of it with a red plastic bucket and spade, a large wave building up in the background, cloudy sky, low angle
video_prompt: two children kneel proudly in front of a big sandcastle on a beach; a large wave rolls in, crashes through the castle and washes the towers away into wet sand and foam, and the children jump back with shocked faces; static low-angle camera
